name: Maria Oehler
title: Congress Coordinator
quote: Seit einem guten Jahr begleitet mich Moritz Lembert als Coach, eine sehr starke, aufgestellte, professionelle Persönlichkeit, die es versteht in schwierigen Lebenssituationen Überblick und Klarheit zu vermitteln. Ich bin einfach nur dankbar und glücklich, Moritz als Coach kennen und schätzen zu dürfen.

name: Kristin Hannon
quote: Over the last two years, I have invested in my personal and professional development by working with Moritz Lembert as my coach. Not because I was stuck, but because I believe that coaching, even when everything is going well, can help you become happier, more efficient, and see yourself and your work with greater clarity. What particularly struck me about working with Moritz is his unique approach to 'surrender' and self-expression in an authentic way. He taught me how to look at my work and life differently and how to manage my thoughts intelligently and with kindness. With his guidance, I learned to work in flow, which had a remarkable impact on my results. I am incredibly grateful to Moritz for his insights, endless patience, and the way he always asks weird but to-the-point questions. Thanks to our conversations, I have not only improved my professional performance but also developed a deeper connection with myself and my loved ones.

name: Felipe Bernardo
title: Leadership Coach & Founder, Servify Studios
quote: At the time of writing, I am on a year-long apprenticeship coaching with Moritz and I must say: there are very few people in my life that have a level of commitment to continuous growth this man has. Moritz is not the same person I knew 11 months ago. Hell, he's not even the same from 1 month ago. I attribute that to what seems like a constant process of getting back to the whiteboard and re-creating himself anew every day. That has an impact on people. It for sure had an impact on me. Besides achieving in 4 months, with his help, most goals I planned to achieve in 1 year, one of my biggest takeaways from our work together was catching on to his ways of being: in integrity with what he says and what he does; highly creative whilst grounded in pragmatism; a true heart-centred leader; an immensely caring and humble husband, friend and mentor; resoundingly truthful to himself and others; a consistent action taker. Meeting with Moritz on a weekly basis for our coaching conversations meant being infected by all of the above, as if to give me permission to be in similar ways in my own life and work. That is a priceless gift. I am blessed. Thank you.

name: Ton Keunen
title: Keynote Speaker, Podcastmaker & Leadership Coach
quote: This guy!! The warmth, joy for life and authentic smile and confrontations are amazing. This man is real and a wonderful, smart and witty coach. Funny and smart. A perfect combination for a life coach and trainer because that is what he is for me. Thank you Moritz. Enjoyed every minute.
